docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
PocketBuddy is a simple and efficient family expense tracking system that allows households to collaboratively manage and monitor their financial activities. Instead of focusing on individual users we focused on family-based structure, where the admin manages family members and oversees shared financial data.

The system enables: - The admin to create accounts for family members. - Each member to log in and manually record their expenses. - The system to generate a combined and categorized family expense overview.

docs.title: Why Choose It
docs.text:
PocketBuddy addresses a common household problem the lack of visibility into overall family spending. Many families use manual logs to track expenses, making it difficult to get a unified picture of household finances.

PocketBuddy simplifies this by: - Centralizing all expenses under one family account. - Allowing members to record transactions in real-time. - Giving the the family clear insights into where money is spent. - Promoting financial collaboration and awareness within the family.

docs.title: Tech Stack
docs.text: Layer Technology Description Frontend HTML, CSS, JavaScript For user interface and chart display Backend FastAPI Handles API requests and database interaction Database PostgreSQL Stores transaction data Moblie PWA Convert the website into a web app for mobile useage Authentication JWT Manages user access

docs.title: Business Use Case
docs.text:
PocketBuddy helps users take control of their daily financial activities by allowing them to: - Add transactions manually anytime. - Categorize their spending. - Visualize monthly expenses through charts. - Track how much they spend in different areas like food, essentials, and entertainment.

It’s ideal for individuals who want a straightforward personal finance tool without connecting to bank accounts or third-party APIs.

docs.title: Business Objectives
docs.text:
• Encourage mindful spending habits.
  • All the family expenses stored colective at one place.
  • Provide a simple digital alternative to rememembering everything.
  • Help users visualize and understand their monthly spending patterns.

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• Manual data entry may be time-consuming.
  • No real-time integration with banking or payment apps.
  • Limited scalability for very large families or organizations.
  • Requires consistent participation from all members for accurate results.

docs.title: Benefits
docs.text:
• Clear visibility of family-wide spending.
  • Promotes shared financial responsibility.
  • Role-based control ensures data privacy and structure.
  • Easy to deploy and maintain.

docs.title: Future Scope
docs.text:
While the current version is manual and simple, PocketBuddy can evolve into a more advanced family finance management platform.

Planned Enhancements: - Integration with banking APIs (Open Banking / UPI) for automatic expense tracking. - AI-based financial suggestions (e.g., savings recommendations). - Multi-currency support for international families. - Expense reminder notifications. - Export data as PDF/Excel reports. - Shared goal tracking (e.g., family savings for vacations or big purchases).

docs.title: Admin Registration
docs.text: Role: Admin Description: The admin creates a family account and initializes the system. Flow: 1. Admin registers using basic details (name, email, password). 2. System creates a unique family ID. 3. Admin logs in to access the family dashboard.

docs.title: Add Family Members
docs.text: Role: Admin Description: Admin creates accounts for each family member. Flow: 1. Admin navigates to “Add Member.” 2. Enters member name, email, and sets a password. 3. The system generates credentials for the member.

docs.title: Add Transaction
docs.text: Role: Family Member Description: Member records an expense or income manually. Flow: 1. Member logs in to their account. 2. Goes to “Add Transaction.” 3. Fills in amount, category, date, and description. 4. Clicks “Save,” and data is stored in the database.

docs.title: View Family Analytics
docs.text: Role: Admin Description: Admin reviews overall family spending and insights. Flow: 1. Admin opens the “Family Dashboard.” 2. System aggregates data from all members. 3. Displays graphical reports of category-wise and member-wise spending.

docs.title: 1. Authentication and Family Management
docs.text:
• Admin (head of family) registers the family account.
  • Admin can create login credentials (user ID and password) for each family member.
  • Family members log in using their assigned credentials.
  • Secure authentication using JWT login.

docs.title: 2. Member Dashboard
docs.text:
• Members can:
  • Add income and expenses manually.
  • Categorize each transaction (Food, Bills, Education, Travel, etc.).
  • View their individual spending summaries.

docs.title: 3. Family Dashboard (Admin View)
docs.text:
• Admin can:
  • View total family income and expenses.
  • View spending breakdown by category and by member.
  • Edit or delete member entries if required.
  • Add or remove family members.

docs.title: 4. Budget Planning (Optional)
docs.text:
• Admin can set monthly or category-wise budgets for the entire family.
  • System tracks progress and alerts when nearing limits.
